title: Kid's Second Wind
flavor: They have one blocker. You have one attacker. Kid laughs at the math.
teaches: A blocker only blocks once — it rests to do it. Swing into the block on purpose, then pay Kid's ability (rest 3 DON!!, trash a card) to stand your leader back up. The second swing has nothing left in its way. Untapping before you attack wastes the once-per-turn.
